summary.text: Traci Koster represents District 66 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected in 2020, according to the House's official biography.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists Koster as a marital and family law attorney from Tampa who was born in Greensboro, North Carolina, and moved to Florida in 1988.

The profile lists a B.S. in legal studies from the University of Central Florida, a J.D. from Stetson University College of Law, and service as president of the Hillsborough County Bar Association's Young Lawyers Division in 2019-2020.
